# Self-Researched E2E Corpus Dedication

All source-language files stored beneath this directory were written from
scratch by the Abate project solely to exercise its seven parsers in the
end-to-end corpus. No byte of any third-party project, and no third-party
licence, is incorporated in these fixtures.

To the extent possible under law, the author, 小黎的部落 (www.qingdujian.com),
waives all copyright and related or neighbouring rights to the corpus bytes in
this directory. The product source code of the Abate repository itself is not
affected by this waiver and keeps its existing dual licence.

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

Scope: every file under this directory whose extension maps to one of the
seven E2E source languages. Verification: cmd/corpusctl computes the SHA-256 of
this declaration and binds it as spdxEvidence to every registered entry, then
recomputes every entry SHA-256 during verify.

Provenance: generated by cmd/corpusgen from ci/e2e_plan.json with the frozen
seed 20261114. Construct families and identifier spellings are original to
this project.
